english_draft: Microsoft’s quarter ended September 30, 2025 (calendar 2025Q3; fiscal 2026 Q1) reported revenue of $77.673bn, operating income of $37.961bn, net income of $27.747bn, and operating cash flow of $45.057bn, all US GAAP and per SEC XBRL. This is not FY2025 Q3. No contemporaneous preview exists. Source review remains pending; annual 10-K figures must not be treated as Q4 standalone.
